description: This Dart source file defines the app theme for a Flutter mobile application, including color palette and theme styling configurations following the Ocean Professional style.

classes.name: AppColors
classes.description: A class that defines the color palette used throughout the application, including primary, secondary, error, background, surface, text colors, and a subtle gradient.

methods.name: buildOceanProfessionalTheme
methods.description: Builds and returns a ThemeData object configured with the Ocean Professional style, customizing colors, text themes, app bar, card, button, divider, and switch themes.
